piezime: Joint plan of Daugavpils valstspilsēta and Augšdaugavas novads; used the 2026-05 updated version (cap_aktualizets_2026_05_gala_novads.md; CA-Plans_14.05.md and 317_lem_public-v001.md are older copies with the same tables, not duplicated). Assembly points: table 5.1 (city, 25 rows / 27 locations, dot decimals; place column is the neighbourhood name) and table 5.2 (Augšdaugavas novads, 40 rows, mostly comma decimals), ch. 5.2, p. 134-138; rows are spread over many table lines in the conversion. Temporary accommodation is in annex 4, marked restricted ('Ierobežotas pieejamības informācija') and not published.
